meta.title: Agents Playground
meta.tagline: Spektrum biomes — click to travel, pan & zoom to explore
meta.note: Public visualization only — stylized biomes, no secrets.

zones.label: Nexus Core
zones.subtitle: Cryoomega origin peak
zones.desc: Central cryo nucleus where mesh resonance roots. Soft ice rings and a calm pulse beacon.
dialogue: Hold the cadence. Every biome answers to the core.
Mesh pulse steady — travel when the rings align.

zones.label: Strategy Overlook
zones.subtitle: High ridges · trade-offs
zones.desc: Cliff terraces and path markers. Direction and priorities sketched across the valley below.
dialogue: Prioritize the ridge path. Skip the shiny canyon for now.
Trade-offs drawn on the overlook. Pick one lane.

zones.label: Architecture Grid Mesa
zones.subtitle: Structure · interfaces
zones.desc: Isometric grid plateaus and wireframe towers. Systems mapped in clean glass lines.
dialogue: Keep the lounge decoupled from the mesa grid.
Interfaces first. Towers follow the mesh edges.

zones.label: Code Neon Canyon
zones.subtitle: Runtime craft · diffs
zones.desc: Vertical neon strata and glowing brackets. Implementation flows like river light through the gorge.
dialogue: Diff landed. Watch the neon edges for regressions.
Runtime is green in the canyon. Ship the next delta.

zones.label: Research Aurora Field
zones.subtitle: Evidence · synthesis
zones.desc: Soft aurora curtains over open tundra. Sources float as light ribbons waiting to be woven.
dialogue: Sources align under the aurora. Frame the claim briefly.
History tail is healthy — synthesize, don't hoard.

zones.label: Writer Mist Valley
zones.subtitle: Narrative · voice
zones.desc: Low mist between soft hills. Words settle as dew — clarity without clutter.
dialogue: Copy is crisp. Mist thins when the sentence earns it.
Drop fluff. One clear line per agent.

zones.label: Critic Sharp Ridges
zones.subtitle: Stress-test · quality
zones.desc: Jagged ice ridges and knife-edge paths. Gaps show clearly in harsh light.
dialogue: Tighten the null path. Then we greenlight.
Edges look sharp from here. Fix the soft spots.

zones.label: Domain Crystal Caves
zones.subtitle: Specialized depth
zones.desc: Faceted crystal chambers underground. Depth on demand — enter only when the question needs it.
dialogue: Depth available. Ask a precise question.
Crystal facets catch only relevant light.

zones.label: Ethicist Calm Ice Garden
zones.subtitle: Boundaries · SafeMode
zones.desc: Quiet ice garden with soft lanterns. Boundaries held gently — harm stays outside the fence.
dialogue: SafeMode holds. Keep secrets out of the garden.
Boundaries clear. Comfort stays optional, harm does not.
